Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: You cannot fix stupid, even with duck tape. I purchased this grill in December 2019 replacing my 20+ year old Weber silver A series grill. Since i reside in a area of the country that gets a lot of snow I waited until April to assemble it. After watching the Bilt app and a video from YouTube I was ready to go. To say the least the Bilt app needs some tweaking. It does not show the E310 model being built. To me it is useless. After three days of trial and error finally the grill is complete. Now the stupid part comes up. While looking for something else, I came across the assembly guide for my grill. I had placed them with the paperwork of my old Weber grill. I had inadvertently placed them there when I received the disassembled grill. As I said before you cannot fix stupid even with duct tape. I have not had a chance to use the grill but am anxiously awaiting to do so.
Results.Title: Instructions
